applies_to: AAON BGC general-purpose controller with 8 analog inputs, 8 binary inputs, 8 relays and 4 analog outputs.
summary: AAON's BACnet MS/TP general controller: a fixed I/O point module with 8 configurable analog inputs (thermistor, 4-20 mA, 0-5/0-10 VDC or communicating sensors), 8 humidity readings from communicating sensors, 8 binary inputs, 8 relay outputs and 4 0-10 VDC analog outputs. The BMS writes the relays and analog outputs directly; the input type, scaling and sensor address are AV settings.
notes: The points table has no read/write column; access is inferred: relay BVs and AV settings writable, AI/BI read-only.
Object names follow the PARAMETER column. AV 29-36 are all printed as 'Sensor #'; the description says which analog input each one serves.
Humidity inputs need a communicating digital temperature/humidity sensor on the matching analog input.
Units of AI 2-9 depend on the input type and scaling set in AV 5-28.

source.title: BACnet General Controller (BGC) Technical Guide - Appendix A BGC BACnet Points

integration.summary: Set the MAC address, ID Start and baud rate on the BGC display, configure each analog input type (AV 5-12) and scaling, then read the inputs and command the relays (BV 1-8) and analog outputs (AV 1-4) from the BMS.
setup: MS/TP baud 9600-76800, default 38400; MAC address 0-254, default 0.
Device ID = ID Start (0-30,000 in steps of 1000, default 15,000) plus the offset shown under DEVICE ID.
Set the jumper next to each analog input to match the selected sensor type (0-5 or 0-10 VDC).
gotchas: AV 5-36 are configuration values; avoid writing them cyclically.
